label: PRIOR_IN_TIME_2: Y is PRIOR_IN_TIME_2 to x when y is or occurs before x
definition: y is prior in time to x when y is or occurs before x. Within one and the same thing that passes from potency to act, the potency is prior in time to the act (ST I q.3 a.1 co.: licet ... prius sit potentia quam actus tempore). Priority in time is not simple priority (DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY): a thing can be first in potency and later in act while its potency still depends on some being in act. The existing TermSenseForks.PriorityFrame.PriorInTime field supplies the temporal relation used by ActPriorInTime and TemporallyFirstBeingInPotency; the latter refutes the temporal branch conditionally.
note: Primitive boundary: the linked declaration projects an independently supplied binary relation on beings from PriorityFrame Being Respect; it is not a definition by temporal, causal or perfection data. See docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md, Priority semantic linkage audit, for interpretation, dependency boundaries, examples, exclusions and OPEN structural constraints. No statement meaning or frozen Challenge changes.

formal_gap.meaning: PriorityFrame.PriorInTime y x says that y is or occurs before x. It is a supplied binary relation on beings; the frame has no clock, time domain or occurrence map from which it is computed.
examples: A seed relative to the mature tree grown from it.
Within one changing thing, its potency precedes its act in time (ST I q.3 a.1); this is about one subject, so it supplies no edge between two distinct beings by itself.
exclusions: Simultaneous dependence: a cause present at the same time as its effect is not thereby prior in time.

Simple priority (PriorSimply) and priority in substance (PriorInSubstance): separate senses in DISAMB-PRIORITY-SIMPLE-OR-IN-TIME; a thing can be first in potency and later in act while its potency still depends on a being in act.
open_obligations: Irreflexivity and transitivity are not imposed by the frame.
Selecting occurrences for persisting beings and an ordered time domain are OPEN.
TemporallyFirstBeingInPotency, which refutes the temporal branch conditionally, is an open analyst premise.
Coverage and exclusivity of the three priority senses (STMT-PRIOR-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE, STMT-PRIOR-SENSE-UNIQUE) remain open frontier premises.

Formalization candidate: with an occurrence map occ : Being → Time into a Mathlib order, define PriorInTime y x := occ y < occ x; this would supply irreflexivity and transitivity by proof, but needs the occurrence data the frame lacks.
